calls: WITNESSED = the FIRST fresh draw (seed order) whose output reads not-RED under the gate by the round's own floats, AND the kernel CHECKS that draw's committed counts break the gate (bend2_vacuity.bend's wit_* over a literal of exactly that draw's per-cue (a, b) or distinct counts), AND the gate read 'as required' over those same counts (vac_*) FAILS; UNKNOWN = no fresh draw reached (reach probability < 3/N at 95%); WITNESS_UNCHECKED = reached, the kernel disagrees (H-REACH not proved). VACUOUS = g5.50's committed vac law re-checked CHECKS and the same for-all with a REACHED witness inserted FAILS (score gates: U_z3enum's first witness, its cue of largest 2ab/v; the distinct gate Mz6: the max of g5.46 MC's first fresh draw)
controls: M-UNDER (a) U_synth: each of 64 samples class A or B with p 1/2 (numpy default_rng(seed).binomial), gate 'score <= 0.05' (mean over 2 cues); (b) U_z3enum: g5.43's Z3-ENUM trained + sampled on the fresh seed, the same gate; each must read WITNESSED within its N, else every UNKNOWN is VOID. M-OVER O_one_image: the cue pair's first-class template repeated 64 times through g5.39's scorer, the same gate over 'all' (g5.50 would call it non-vacuous): must NOT read WITNESSED, else VOID
draw0: fidelity.json + draws/<gate>.draw0.jsonl: each driver on its round's OWN first seed reproduces the round's committed numbers EXACTLY (8 of 8 applicable, one BLAS thread); a driver that does not is VOID for its gate. Draw 0 is the round's committed output, reported, never counted in N
drivers: each gate's draw repeats, line for line, its round's run_seed block for that gate (M2: the TRUE + COIN block; MC: the 512-line block; Mz2 / Z3-ENUM: g543 run_seed's setup + train_code + the TEST sampling; MK: g546 run_seed's setup + train_cv(zero_z=True) + TEST and RICH sampling), importing the round's own modules from git archive of its pre-run (g5.39 7b75964aea, g5.41 cee90e7bff, g5.43 f93be0f7b3, g5.46 29b9084b23); g5.50's M2 for g5.39 / .41 / .43 / .46 and MC / Mz2 / MK are the 7 NON-vacuous gates
h_reach: PROVED iff >= 1 of the 7 non-vacuous gates reads UNKNOWN AND all 5 VACUOUS stay VACUOUS AND no WITNESS_UNCHECKED; RED (disproved) iff all 7 read WITNESSED, or a vacuous call breaks, or a witness is unchecked; VOID per params void_rule
